recommendations.name: Pubudu Mihiranga
recommendations.highlight: Truly one of the most exceptional managers I've had in my career.
recommendations.text:
I had the privilege of working with Dilum at Circles, and he is truly one of the most exceptional managers I've had in my career.

From the very start, Dilum's approach to the interview process was straightforward and insightful, setting a positive tone for our working relationship. As soon as I joined Circles as an intern Engineer, Dilum took me under his wing, providing invaluable guidance and mentorship that laid a solid foundation for my career. Thanks to his foundation, I was promoted twice (from Intern Engineer to Associate Engineer to Engineer I) in an impressively short period.

One of Dilum's most admirable qualities is his dedication to the holistic development of his team members. He consistently encouraged me to pursue excellence not only in my professional endeavors but also in my personal and academic pursuits. As a result, I was honored to receive the award for batch topper in the University of Westminster's Class of 23, a milestone I attribute largely to Dilum's unwavering support and encouragement.

Furthermore, Dilum emphasized the importance of maintaining a healthy work-life balance. He not only stressed the significance of continuous learning but also urged me to engage in extracurricular activities such as reading and writing in tech and volunteering in the tech communities. His guidance enabled me to navigate the complexities of balancing work, academics, and personal life, allowing me to thrive in all aspects.

Without hesitation, I highly recommend Dilum for any role that requires people management. I am confident that his expertise, dedication, and mentorship will continue to positively impact those around him.

He embraced personal development in his technical craft and I am sure that he will find many growth opportunities as a result.

recommendations.name: Rukshan Perera
recommendations.highlight: Displayed great tenacity and took up challenges with no hesitation.
recommendations.text:
Dilum during his time working with me displayed great tenacity and took up challenges with no hesitation. He was involved in a project that required heavy R&D due to the newness of the application and lack of available support literature. He worked and delivered the project deliverables with tight deadlines despite these constraints. It was truly a pleasure working with a team player who can be trusted to perform under challenging circumstances. He also has a good attitude and got along well his other associates within the company.

I would without hesitation recommend Dilum to any prospective employers.

All the best Dilum and thank you for your hard work.

recommendations.name: Yasith Abeynayaka
recommendations.highlight: Amazed by Dilum's ability to understand concepts very quickly and apply them in real life context.
recommendations.text:
Dilum is among the handful of university students who succeeded in completing the 10-week introductory program on Industrial Product Design conducted by Cambio Healthcare Systems. Throughout the 10 week program, he was mentored by seasoned designers from our team to design a product from scratch where he mastered design research methods, how to understand the context of use, defining design challenges, ideation techniques, product concept development including design sketching, techniques to evaluate concepts, testing with users and creative storytelling.

As his mentors, we were amazed by Dilum's ability to understand concepts very quickly and apply them in real life context. He designed an amazing product he branded Xtro 2.2, solving human-centered problems of the tech industry employees with high screen time. The design and product concept includes the right balance of desirability, feasibility, and viability. Further, We were privileged to experience his professionalism, technical know-how, and creativity, further, we have our highest recommendation for challenging assignments that demand creative and innovative thinking.
